public class WaterTank {
    private int capacity;
    private int liters;

    public WaterTank(int maxCapacity, int startingLiters) {
        capacity = maxCapacity;
        liters = startingLiters;
    }

    public int getCapacity() {
        return capacity;
    }

    public int getLiters() {
        return liters;
    }

    public boolean addWater(int amount) {
        if (amount <= 0 || amount > capacity - liters) {
            return false;
        }
        liters += amount;
        return true;
    }

    public boolean transferTo(WaterTank other, int amount) {
        if (amount <= 0 || amount > liters || amount > other.capacity - other.liters) {
            return false;
        }
        liters -= amount;
        other.liters += amount;
        return true;
    }

    public WaterTank chooseLowerLevel(WaterTank first, WaterTank second) {
        if (first.liters <= second.liters) {
            return first;
        }
        return second;
    }

    public boolean hasMoreRoomThan(WaterTank other) {
        return capacity - liters > other.capacity - other.liters;
    }
}
